title: Transcoding worker pool: capacity that shrinks over time
name: Transcode worker pool

questions.prompt: Transcoding hosts slowly stop doing work. A freshly started host encodes at full speed, but after a few hours, typically after a batch of broken uploads from one creator, its CPU sits near idle while the queue of videos stuck in "processing" keeps growing. Restarting the host fixes it for a while. Fix transcode/pool.ts so the tests pass.
